There are 7 ratio fields with naming pattern "DEFERRED_TAX_EXPENSE_XX", where XX denotes the index of denominator. We use (Net deferred tax liability - Net deferred tax liability) as numerator and different groups of denominators. E.g. "DEFERRED_TAX_LIABILITY_XX"  indicates use of the 2nd candidate of denominators group 1.
